summary.text: Eric Wimberger is a Republican member of the Wisconsin Senate representing District 2, based in Gillett, and has been elected to the Senate since 2020.
He is co-chair of the Joint Legislative Audit Committee and also serves on the Finance and Judiciary and Public Safety committees.

paragraphs.text: Wimberger was born in Green Bay, Wisconsin, on April 2, 1979.
He earned a B.A. in criminal justice from St. Cloud State University in 2001 and a J.D. from Marquette University Law School in 2005.
The Legislature's page describes him as an attorney and small business owner who operates a family-owned candy store in Lakewood and a law practice.
It says he served as a captain in the U.S. Marine Corps Judge Advocate General's Corps from 2006 to 2010 and previously worked as a long-haul truck driver for Schneider National and as a bartender.
He is also a member of the Commission on Uniform State Laws.
